title: Contagion de sceau
question: Avec sa nouvelle mécanique, veux-tu que Désorientation puisse aussi être transmise par Contagion de sceau ? La liste actuelle comprend Interférence, Faille d’armure, Silence et Rupture de régénération.
accepted_scope: Explicit addition of redesigned AF05 to AF06 compatibility list; existing four effects preserved. Does not by itself approve numerical scaling, targeting details, fatal-damage ordering, new copy or animation.
fatal_damage_ordering_proposal: For death caused by damage, a directly applied compatible effect active immediately before fatal damage may be selected for transmission; thus AF05 can propagate despite interruption by that fatal damage. A previous nonfatal hit that removed AF05 does not leave a transmissible effect. Proposed exception remains pending displayed-tooltip review.
control_scope: Any transmitted control retains CTRL01 boss immunity and elite 0.75 calculated-chance multiplier; no bypass by passive propagation.
